messages.author: 9f63b29165db45be
messages.subject: Warnings in Eigen source code
parts:
I am getting some warnings in the Eigen source code when I build TMB; e.g.,

/home/bradbell/R/library/TMB/include/Eigen/src/Core/products/GeneralBlockPanelKernel.h:574:9:
warning: this ‘if’ clause does not guard... [-Wmisleading-indentation]
          if(nr==4) traits.initAcc(C3);

I have been able to get around these (in packages that I maintain) by treating the Eigen include directory like a system include directory; e.g., with gcc use the -isystem flag; see

https://listengine.tuxfamily.org/lists.tuxfamily.org/eigen/2016/03/msg00009.html

messages.author: 90b303eef43fd993
messages.subject: RE: [TMB users] Warnings in Eigen source code
parts:
Thanks for the hint.

I get the same warnings (on fedora only). But if I update to eigen v3.3.2:

git checkout eigen_3.3.2
git rebase master
make install

The warnings are gone...
